card: Adds microbenchmarks for BIP-352 Silent Payments public key extraction (GetPubKeyFromInput). It measures performance across standard input types (P2PKH, P2SH-P2WPKH, P2WPKH, P2TR) as well as an adversarial worst-case malleated P2PKH scriptSig. This provides baseline metrics and regression detection for ongoing changes to silent payments input parsing.
evidence: PR description notes ongoing modifications to Silent Payments extraction: 'As there are ongoing changes to the Silent Payments public key extraction function GetPubKeyFromInput (see recently merged #36338, upcoming #36417), it seems reasonable to add benchmarks for it.'
Author benchmark measurements demonstrate standard inputs process at ~2.7-3.0 µs/input while the worst-case malleated P2PKH scriptSig drops throughput by over an order of magnitude to ~69.9 µs/input.
problem: Silent Payments input parsing and key extraction logic undergoes ongoing refinements and bug fixes, but lacks dedicated benchmarks to detect performance regressions or quantify overhead in adversarial worst-case malleated scriptSig inputs.

risk.why: Only adds benchmark executable test code and does not touch production consensus, validation, or wallet code.

summary: Adds microbenchmarks for BIP-352 Silent Payments public key extraction in bench_bitcoin. It measures the performance of bip352::GetPubKeyFromInput across standard input types (P2PKH, P2SH-P2WPKH, P2WPKH, and P2TR key-path) and an adversarial worst-case P2PKH input that packs the scriptSig with 33-byte pushes.
